standard.summary: Resource Manager 监控显存使用并动态调整 batch size、梯度累积步数和 checkpoint 策略，在显存压力下自动优化而不崩溃。
standard.effect: rm_enable_adaptive_batch 允许自动调整 batch size（min~max 范围）。rm_enable_adaptive_accumulation 允许调整梯度累积。rm_vram_warning_threshold 控制预警阈值。
standard.whenToUse: 显存紧张或运行不同模型时想让系统自动管理显存。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要固定 batch size 进行基准测试时。频繁调整 batch size 会影响训练一致性。

standard_en.summary: The Resource Manager watches VRAM use and adjusts the batch size, the gradient accumulation steps and the checkpointing strategy dynamically, optimising under memory pressure instead of crashing.
standard_en.effect: rm_enable_adaptive_batch allows the batch size to be adjusted automatically (within a min~max range). rm_enable_adaptive_accumulation allows gradient accumulation to be adjusted. rm_vram_warning_threshold sets the early-warning threshold.
standard_en.whenToUse: When VRAM is tight, or when you run different models and want the system to manage memory itself.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need a fixed batch size for benchmarking. Adjusting the batch size often affects training consistency.

advanced.principle: 三级阈值管理：warning（0.85）→ 日志提醒；critical（0.92）→ 触发自动调整（降 batch/增 accumulation/激活 checkpoint）；emergency（0.97）→ 强制保护措施。rm_enable_peak_tracking 追踪显存峰值用于更准确的阈值判断。rm_enable_adaptive_cpu_offload 在 VRAM 超过阈值时自动激活 CPU offload。
advanced.intervention: 每 N 步检查显存 → 阈值判断 → 触发对应级别的自适应调整。
advanced.expectedImpact: 显著减少 OOM 崩溃。自动管理显存无需手动调参。
advanced.tradeoffs: 自适应调整会改变 effective batch size，可能影响收敛速度。

advanced_en.principle: Three-level threshold management: warning (0.85) → log reminder; critical (0.92) → triggers automatic adjustments (lower batch / raise accumulation / enable checkpointing); emergency (0.97) → forced protective measures. rm_enable_peak_tracking tracks VRAM peaks for more accurate threshold judgment. rm_enable_adaptive_cpu_offload automatically activates CPU offload when VRAM exceeds the threshold.
advanced_en.intervention: Checks VRAM every N steps → threshold judgment → triggers the matching level of adaptive adjustment.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Markedly fewer OOM crashes; VRAM is managed automatically with no manual tuning.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Adaptive adjustment changes the effective batch size, which can affect convergence speed.
